question: Can intervention-scoped partition refinement compress true implementation duplicates while refusing to merge states that are indistinguishable on normal paths but causally distinct under Frank-like interventions?
test_sequences: all action sequences length 1..3 plus 500 seeded length-4 sequences
causal_discriminator: Normal actions intentionally hide causal mode; intervention actions reveal it. Four duplicate implementations of each causal mode are exactly equivalent and should collapse.
promotion_rule: Synthetic PASS only justifies a real Frank shadow-test obligation; it cannot promote CQC into the target architecture.
real_next_test: After executable current loop-core and applicable Original Baseline traces exist, encode one bounded historical/current component pair as protected labeled transitions, compare manual baseline vs CQC on matched lesion/reentry/recovery/effect controls, and run on accepted target VPS.
